newsitem.title: CROATIA: TENNIS-RADULESCU FORCED TO RETIRE AGAINST TOP SEED IVANISEVIC.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RADULESCU FORCED TO RETIRE AGAINST TOP SEED IVANISEVIC.

text.p: German Alex Radulescu was forced to quit his Croatian indoor quarter-final against titleholder Goran Ivanisevic on Friday because of a back injury.
World number two Ivanisevic had swept through the first set without dropping a game and the score stood at 1-1 in the second when Radulescu retired.
Ivanisevic will meet fifth-seeded Spaniard Javier Sanchez, a 6-0 7-6 winner over Argentine Gaston Etlis, in the semifinals.

Second seed Thomas Enqvist of Sweden reached the last four by beating Morrocan Hicham Arazi 6-2 6-3. He will play Briton Greg Rusedski of Britain, a 7-5 6-3 winner over Martin Damm of the Czech Republic.
